verdict.rationale: Airwallex is a financial and payments platform, not an agent or AI host, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is outside its product role. The evidence shows only that Airwallex publishes its own MCP servers (the AgentOS MCP and the Developer and Docs MCPs) for external agents to connect to. That is the server role, which belongs to a different story and does not make this client axis applicable.
